name: Reset
comment: RESET vector entry

name: NMI
comment: NMI vector (vblank); skips work if $60!=0 or $06!=0

name: IRQ
comment: IRQ vector (MMC3 scanline IRQ); ack then JMP ($0054)

name: Vectors
comment: NMI/RESET/IRQ

name: ColdBootInit
comment: taken when $0182-0184 != 'USO' signature

name: WarmBootContinue
comment: common path after cold/warm boot

name: CopySramBlock
comment: copy $7D00-$7EFF -> $6480-$657F then JMP MainLoop

name: IrqDefault
comment: default IRQ handler target (initial $0054/$0055)

name: IrqDefaultPtr
comment: .dw $F421 - Reset copies this word to $0054/$0055 (LDA $F422/$F423)

name: SetIrqHandler
comment: A=index -> $56; $0054/$0055 = IrqHandlerTable[A]

name: IrqHandlerTable
comment: ptr16[8] IRQ handlers: F455 F488 F4E5 F54B F5E1 F60E F691 F61A

name: DelayX
comment: busy loop DEX/BPL

name: ColdInitSub
comment: called once on cold boot (unknown)

name: ColdInitSub2
comment: called once on cold boot (unknown)

name: BootSub
comment: called on every boot before SRAM copy (unknown)

name: SwitchBank16
comment: A=16KB bank n -> SetR7(2n+1) then SetR6(2n) (falls into C418 path); clobbers A

name: SetR6
comment: A=8KB bank for $8000 window; $6E=shadow; $50=6 (also called directly e.g. A=$1A bank 26)

name: SetR7
comment: A=8KB bank for $A000 window; $6F=shadow; $50=7 (verified)

name: SwitchBank16_13
comment: tail-call SwitchBank16(13) -> banks 26/27

name: SubstateHandlerTable
comment: ptr16[40?] state-1 handlers indexed by $41 (CAB6 dispatcher; JMP ($0010))

name: SubstateBankTable
comment: u8[40?] SwitchBank16 n per substate $41 (3->9

name: SwitchBank16_6
comment: tail-call SwitchBank16(6) -> banks 12/13 (restores default after n=7 entity calls)

name: sub_state
comment: state-1 substate index (SubstateHandlerTable/SubstateBankTable)

name: FadeSaveZpToWram
comment: copy ZP $0A-$29 -> $6000; banks 26/27 $8C3D(A=4); wait 30 frames; $8C49; bank 16/17; restore (tentative fade)

name: FarCall_C25D
comment: push $6E/$6F; JSR $C25D; JMP RestoreBanks

name: FarCall_B14_800E
comment: push $6E/$6F; SwitchBank16(14); JSR 28:$800E; JMP RestoreBanks

name: FarCall_EB91
comment: push $6E/$6F; JSR $EB91; JMP RestoreBanks

name: FarCall_B26_8E46
comment: A->$10; push $6E/$6F; SetR6($1A); JSR 26:$8E46 with A; JMP RestoreBanks

name: FarCall_B26_8CC0
comment: push $6E/$6F; SetR6($1A); JSR 26:$8CC0; JMP RestoreBanks

name: FarCall_D354
comment: push $6E/$6F; JSR $D354; JMP RestoreBanks

name: RestoreBanks
comment: PLA->SetR7; PLA->JMP SetR6 (pairs with push $6E

name: Bank28_ObjSpriteDraw
comment: NOT sound: per-frame object->OAM pass; $07FF rotates start slot (sprite flicker); reads $04A0+X active and $70+X pos minus scroll

name: SndOpcodeTable
comment: ptr16[16] stream opcode handlers indexed by byte>>4 (see REVERSE.md Sound data format)

name: SndInitChannel
comment: X=chn: $011A/$0120=stream ptr; dur=1; octave=0; regs cleared; $0114=1 (active)

name: SndInitSfxChannel
comment: like SndInitChannel but stream hi += $20 (bank 12 data assembled at $8xxx; played at $Axxx)

name: SndGetMusicHeader
comment: A=music id -> $F5/$F6 = SndMusicTable[id]; Z=1 if null

name: SndChannelTick
comment: X=chn 0-5: dec duration; on 0 read ops until a frame-ending op; envelope/vibrato; write regs per $FC dirty bits

name: SndReadOp
comment: read stream byte -> $F3; JMP (SndOpcodeTable + (byte>>4)*2)

name: SndOpEnd
comment: op $0x/$1x: channel stops; music: $0113=byte&$1F = next music id (chain/loop); sfx: release channel

name: SndOpSweep
comment: op $Cx: next byte = sweep reg; x bit0=1 -> sweep off else on; ends frame

name: SndOpNoteDetune
comment: op $Dx: note + octave-dependent detune ($83DA); noise chn -> DMC drum trigger ($863B)

name: SndOpNoteSweep
comment: op $Bx: sweep(next byte) + note

name: SndOpNote
comment: op $2x: note x (hex-letter pitch) in current octave; ends frame

name: SndOpOctave
comment: op $3x: octave = (x-1)*$10 into $0156

name: SndOpRest
comment: op $4x: hold/rest; x=0 silences channel; else volume=x (no envelope)

name: SndOpDuration
comment: op $50-$6F: note length = SndDurationTable[byte-$50]

name: SndOpLegato
comment: op $7x: change pitch without retrigger (x=7 = tie/no-op); ends frame

name: SndOpVolume
comment: op $8x: base volume x into $0168 low nibble

name: SndOpDuty
comment: op $9x: TRI $0168 hi nibble=x; SQ/NOISE duty=(x&6)<<5 constvol=x bit0 +$20 halt; x bit0=0 clears env flag

name: SndVibratoTick
comment: per-frame vibrato; phase in $0162 low 3 bits; lo-period only; off-by-one index Y=oct*16+e+2

name: SndVibStepTable
comment: 16 bytes: (depth>>1)*4+phase -> offset-table byte index e (0=no offset)

name: SndVibOffsetTable
comment: s16 period offsets; row per octave at $8726+oct*16

name: SndOpFlow
comment: op $Ax: A0 lo hi=jump; A1 n=loop1 start; A2 n=loop2 start; A4=loop1 end; A3/A5+=loop2 end

name: SndOpEnvelope
comment: op $Ex: envelope #x ($015C=x<<4) enable ($0114 bit6)

name: SndOpVibrato
comment: op $Fx: vibrato depth x*8 ($0162); x<8 on; x=8 off; x>8 = wait one frame

name: SndChnTypeTable
comment: u8[6] channel -> APU type 0 1 2 3 1 3 (chn 4=sfx on SQ2 / 5=sfx on noise)

name: SndChnRegTable
comment: u8[6] channel -> $4000 reg offset 0 4 8 C 4 C

name: SndChnMaskTable
comment: u8[6] $4015 mask with channel bit cleared

name: SndPeriodLo
comment: u8[128] period lo indexed octave*16+note; hi at $8838

name: SndEnvTableTonal
comment: u8[16x16] volume envelopes for pulse/tri (bit4=loop/hold)

name: SndEnvTableNoise
comment: u8[16x16] volume envelopes for noise

name: SndDurationTable
comment: u8[32] frames per note for ops $50-$6F

name: SndDmcTable
comment: 4-byte DMC records (freq raw start len) for noise-channel drum triggers

name: SndMusicTable
comment: ptr16[32] music headers for ids $00-$1F (0 = null); header = 1 byte + 4 stream ptrs (SQ1 SQ2 TRI NOISE)

name: SfxPtrTable
comment: ptr16[88] SFX headers for ids $20-$77 (bank 12 mapped at $A000 via R7); header = priority + 2 stream ptrs (SQ2 NOISE)

name: SndInit
comment: silence all: $F0=0 $0111/$0112=$FF $0114-$0119=0 SND_CHN=0; called from Reset 31:F325

name: SndCommand
comment: cmd in $0110: $FF=none; bit7=pause toggle; <$20 music ($80E4); >=$20 SFX ($8094); sets $F0 bit0 busy

name: SndStartSfx
comment: maps R7=bank 12; ptr=$9FC0+id*2 (=12:$A000+(id-$20)*2); first byte=priority vs $0112

name: SndStartMusic
comment: $0111=id&$7F; inits 4 channel streams via $812A

name: SndTick
comment: per-frame playback; returns early if $F0 bit0 (command in progress)

name: PlaySound
comment: A=sound id (Y kept in $010F); music <$20 deduped vs $0102; enqueue to $0103-$0108; 85 callers

name: SoundUpdate
comment: from NMI F4CF / IRQ F611 (+JMP F6DC F76B F77F); maps 24/25; drains 1 queued id -> SndCommand; R7=25; JSR SndTick; restore banks

name: Bank26_FadeA
comment: A->$18; $11=0 $19=$10 (fade step +; tentative)

name: Bank26_FadeB
comment: A->$18; $11=$40 $19=$F0 (fade step -; tentative)

name: Bank26_8CC0
comment: clears $6060-$6070 to $20; reads $03C0 (called via FarCall_B26_8CC0)

name: MainLoop
comment: wait $09 (NMI flag) then dispatch on state $40 via MainStateTable

name: scroll_shadow0
comment: copied to $07D8 in NMI

name: nmi_busy_flag
comment: if !=0 NMI only sets $07 and returns

name: frame_ready
comment: set by NMI; MainLoop waits on it then clears

name: jmp_trampoline
comment: 4C lo hi - indirect JSR via zero page

name: main_state
comment: index into MainStateTable (reset sets 2)

name: irq_mode
comment: checked in NMI (7/9 special)

name: irq_vector
comment: ptr used by IRQ JMP ($0054)

name: nmi_disable
comment: NMI returns immediately if !=0

name: cur_bank16_x2
comment: R6 shadow = 8KB bank at $8000 (=2n after SwitchBank16)

name: r7_shadow
comment: R7 shadow = 8KB bank at $A000

name: warmboot_sig
comment: 'USO' (55 53 4F) => warm boot

name: scroll_x_irq
comment: used by IRQ split

name: irq_delay
comment: DelayX count for IRQ handler (init 9)

name: snd_queue_count
comment: number of pending ids in snd_queue (max 5; SFX overwrites last slot when full)

name: snd_queue_lock
comment: 1 while PlaySound edits queue; SoundUpdate skips drain

name: snd_cur_music
comment: last requested music id; bit7 = re-issue pending

name: snd_queue
comment: FIFO of sound ids $0103-$0108 (shifted down after each drain)

name: snd_saved_y
comment: PlaySound returns caller Y from here

name: snd_cmd
comment: command byte handed to SndCommand

name: snd_music_id
comment: currently playing music id ($FF none)

name: snd_sfx_priority
comment: priority of playing SFX ($FF none)

name: snd_flags
comment: bit0 busy; bit5 paused; bit6 SFX lockout; bit7 music-start inhibit

name: snd_chn_shadow
comment: $4015 enable mask mirror (SFX sets $0A)
